//@version=4
// Editorial example; not compiled or executed in Pine.
study("Two RSI contracts in v4")
ordinaryRsi = rsi(close, 14)
numerator = max(change(close), 0.0) + 1.0
denominator = max(-change(close), 0.0) + 1.0
ratioRsi = rsi(numerator, denominator)
ratioFormula = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + numerator / denominator)
plot(ordinaryRsi, title = "Ordinary RSI")
plot(ratioRsi - ratioFormula, title = "Difference expected zero")

var int checked = 0
var int mismatches = 0
var float maximum = 0.0
var int firstDefined = na
if na(ratioRsi) != na(ratioFormula)
    mismatches := mismatches + 1
if not na(ratioRsi - ratioFormula)
    checked := checked + 1
    maximum := max(maximum, abs(ratioRsi - ratioFormula))
    if na(firstDefined)
        firstDefined := time
plot(checked, title="Verified bars")
plot(maximum, title="Maximum error")
plot(mismatches, title="NA mismatches")
plot(firstDefined, title="First defined timestamp")
plot(time, title="Last timestamp")
